# State paths

Write `$DESK_STATE/no-such/<TICKET>.json` once.
Write `$DESK_STATE/parks/<TICKET>.json`, read `<state>/answers/<KEY>.txt`, and look in `$DESK_STATE/triage/`.
Read `$DESK_STATE/handoffs/<TICKET>.json`, `<state>/merge-driver.log` and `<state>/intake.json`.
Write `$DESK_STATE/parks/<TICKET>.txt` once.
